scientific.integrity: The primary publisher PDF was inspected at the model equations, positivity argument, invariant-region construction, disease-free global-stability section, and Table 1 parameter values; the invariant-region page was visually inspected. The target source's publication date and primary MSC were verified from the publisher record. A prior environmental Buruli model and a closely related 2021 possum-model publication were checked for broader coverage. Exact symbolic and rational replay verifies the corrected cap and boundary counterexample. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result corrects the rectangular feasible-region argument. It does not independently reassess the article's later equilibrium or stability theorems, and a smaller nonrectangular absorbing set may be obtainable from sharper coupled estimates.

title: The environmental cap in the possum Buruli-ulcer feasible region is not invariant
